input.summary: Settled 3 of 21 controls on clear habit evidence: kb_a to mp_left_center_puff (normal), kb_s to mp_left_center_sip (toggle), kb_left_shift to mp_triple_puff (delay_on) - all lopsided majorities for the same job across their other games. The remaining 18 needed a question rather than a guess: kb_left_control and kb_f have a known job here but split/ambiguous history on input or function, so I offered their top recorded choices. kb_c, kb_q, kb_y, and all four dpad directions have no sourced description of what they do in this game, so even where their history is strongly lopsided (e.g. dpad_N at 46%) I asked rather than assumed the job matches. kb_z, kb_e, kb_f2, right_trigger, left_trigger, Y, right_bumper, left_bumper, and X have neither a known in-game job nor any binding history at all, so I asked what they should do with only a 'leave unbound' fallback offered.
